summary: Researches global news and US television coverage via the Crawlora API — GDELT web-news search/context/timeline/sentiment, plus GDELT Television 2.0 AI's index of US TV transcripts, captions, on-screen text, and visual labels — returning clean JSON. Use when the user wants coverage-volume or sentiment trends over time, cross-outlet news search, sentence-level co-occurrence search, or what US TV news said/showed about a topic — OSINT, media-monitoring, and political/social-science research.
